carried_from: RELEASE_CHANGE_MANIFEST.json of v16.4.4 (repairs SEC-301..SEC-307 remain in effect)

evidence.separation: Campaign 3A evidence no longer ships inside the governed source tree. 233 tracked evidence files were untracked (git rm --cached; content preserved on disk and in git history) and colab-evidence/ is now gitignored. The evidence artifact mini-AGI-Campaign3A-Evidence.zip carries its own EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json, signature and provenance; the historical Campaign 3A REFUSED result is preserved unmodified.

repairs.behavior: pickle.dumps/pickle.load removed from the supervisor-worker channel with no fallback path. Frames are 4-byte big-endian length-prefixed JSON validated against a closed schema (protocol, request id, type, bounded payload); payload digests and announced lengths are checked; frame and result sizes are bounded; malformed, oversized, truncated, unexpected, or hostile bytes fail the worker channel without executing anything in the supervisor. WorkerProtocolViolation subclasses WorkerDied so protocol abuse and worker death converge on the same safe handling. Workers launch under an explicit restricted environment (credential-name filtering for KEY/TOKEN/SECRET/PASSWORD/CREDENTIAL), a private 0700 scratch directory for TMP/TMPDIR/TEMP, optional rlimits, optional uid/gid demotion, and a separate process group. MeasuredSnapshot refuses pickling; cross-process transport is a descriptor resolved to staged files whose bytes are re-measured in the receiving process and compared to expected authorization digests.
repairs.title: Unsafe worker-process IPC replaced by strict framed JSON v2

repairs.behavior: AuthorityStore now retains the signed authority documents (plan, qualification, promotion decision, runtime manifest) presented at first admission. Cold-start restoration never mints authority from a durable pointer or from fallback digests: RestorationAuthorizationVerifier re-verifies the complete historical chain (valid promotion signature, binding digests matching the restoration target, backend still qualified, policy epoch current, revocation snapshot valid/monotonic/not rolled back, artifact bytes re-measured against authorized digests) and refuses on any missing or revoked evidence. A fresh grant bound to the operative revocation epoch is issued per restoration; authorize() and commit_activation() re-check the operative epoch and explicit decision/key revocation at commit time, closing the authorize->prepare->commit race. Newly revoked active models are route-withdrawn and quarantined before fallback selection; revoked predecessors are retired first so a revoked model can never be selected as fallback. No eligible model => UNAVAILABLE.
repairs.title: Revoke-aware authorization, activation, rollback, and cold restoration

repairs.behavior: The v16.4.4 zip shipped a manifest generated before part of its source: 18 governed files hashed differently and 233 tracked campaign-evidence files plus untracked archives were unmanifested. For v16.4.5 the governed set is defined as git ls-files intersected with disk; campaign evidence is removed from the source manifest entirely and ships as mini-AGI-Campaign3A-Evidence.zip with its own manifest, signature and provenance. reissue_release.py no longer silently generates a signing key when the pinned release key is absent. The pipeline is: freeze source and metadata, regenerate SOURCE_MANIFEST.json, sign with the pinned release key, reconcile RELEASE_ATTESTATION.json (manifest_sha256, reissued_utc, reissue_history, release name), rebuild the ZIP deterministically, extract into a clean directory, and re-verify. A file_changes ledger below records every added/modified governed file with old and new sha256 and its repair id; pre-existing v16.4.4 drift that this release does not otherwise touch is reconciled under SEC-403.
repairs.title: Release integrity repaired; source and campaign evidence separated

repairs.behavior: The spawn child entry point moved into tests-python/helpers/grant_ledger_worker.py so spawn children can import it under --import-mode=importlib. The harness distinguishes worker import failure, a hung child (terminated and reported), a child that exits without reporting, worker-reported errors, and genuine double-consumption. It runs under spawn plus other supported start methods; fork is excluded on macOS where sqlite-using children cannot run after fork (system libdispatch state), a documented platform limitation rather than a masked failure.
repairs.title: Grant-ledger multiprocessing test made importable and diagnostic

repairs.behavior: Closed in the post-v16.4.4 change set and manifested for the first time under this release. SignedAttemptReceipt carries the WP10 field set under an evaluator Ed25519 signature; select_mechanism requires one verified receipt per cheaper rung, bound to the same evidence_digest, with outcome != INVALID, verified under a trusted evaluator verifier. Raw digests, unsigned receipts, untrusted signers, foreign-evidence receipts, and wrong-rung receipts are rejected (19 gate tests).
repairs.title: Mechanism controller requires verified signed attempt receipts

repairs.behavior: Closed in the post-v16.4.4 change set and manifested for the first time under this release. NO_CHANGE is selected whenever the best admissible utility fails to strictly exceed the frozen ObjectiveWeights.utility_threshold (tau=0 default); abstention is distinct from the DIAGNOSTIC_EXPERIMENT path, which remains for the nothing-clears-the-floor case; exhausted-budget refusal, atomic charge accounting and signed exhaustion records are exercised by the gate tests.
repairs.title: Selector abstains below the utility floor instead of picking least-bad

summary: Security and evidence closure: revoked promotions can no longer activate or be cold-restored, worker-controlled IPC can no longer deserialize into the supervisor (pickle removed; strict framed JSON v2 with bounded, digested, schema-checked frames), workers launch under an explicit restricted environment with private scratch and resource limits, MeasuredSnapshot transport re-measures bytes in the receiving process, and the release pipeline is repaired so every governed file is enumerated, hashed, signed under the pinned release key, and verified on fresh extraction. Campaign 3A evidence is split into a separately manifested artifact.
